title: Saturn Super Vol. 5
native_title: サターン・スーパー Ｖｏｌ．５
overview:
The demo disc released with the fifth volume of Saturn Super magazine, packed with playable demos of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Albert Odyssey: Legend of Eldean
- Dark Savior
- Lode Runner: The Legend Returns
- Mahjong Hyper Reaction R
- Kururin Pa!
- Vampire Hunter
- 2do Arukotoha Sand-R
